input.request: Build Warranty Bond, a product-warranty bond page. Token name: Warranty Bond. Token symbol: WRNT. The fixed total supply is 1,000,000,000 tokens with 18 decimals (1,000,000,000 * 10^18 base units), minted once to the deployer. WarrantyBond lets a seller post a bond for a bytes32 product serial and expiry, a buyer register ownership, and the buyer open a claim before expiry; the seller accepts a claim to pay the bond or the buyer withdraws an uncontested claim exactly 7 days after opening it. Deploy on Sepolia and publish a page to post bonds, register products and manage claims.
input.context: Sepolia only (chainId 11155111); GitHub and IPFS are approved. Include Foundry tests and an independent adversarial review. Constructors use only address, uint256, bool or bytes32 arguments; the launch token constructor is zero-argument. foundry.toml must set bytecode_hash = "none". No proxy, delegatecall or selfdestruct. Sellers fund bonds, buyers register and claim, and either party calls resolution because the call protects or releases its own funds.

draft.objective: Build and review WRNT and WarrantyBond, deploy them on Sepolia, then publish the live warranty-bond website.

steps.objective: Implement fixed-supply WRNT and bonded warranty claims.
Test serial uniqueness, ownership, claim windows, payout and refusal paths.
Independently adversarially review all warranty state transitions.
Build the live product warranty page with transaction-safe claim states.
